td-4-066.title: The Greasy Axis
td-4-066.text: Heavy iron collars rotate in the gloom with a rhythmic, bone-deep thrum that vibrates through the soles of your boots. Slick black grease coats the cylindrical housing, smelling of ancient tallow and stagnant bottom-water. Beneath the rolling metal spine, pale blind eels coil in nests of rusted copper wire, their lidless eyes milky and their jaws snapping reflexively at the dark grease. You crouch low, testing the slick curve of the axle with your palms while waiting for the gap between rotating braces to widen just enough for a desperate scramble.

td-4-067.title: Snapping Jaws Below
td-4-067.text: Cold spray spits from a high fissure somewhere above, turning the grease on the spinning shaft into a treacherous paste. Each rotation threatens to sweep your boots off the curved iron, pitching you straight into the writhing tangle of blind eels waiting in the dark void beneath. You tuck your elbows tight against your ribs and slide forward on your belly, using your forearms to gauge the speed of the grinding metal while your fingers brush against a damp nest wedged into a service bracket.

td-4-068.title: Plucking the Pearl
td-4-068.text: A milky glob as large as a gull egg rests in the center of the eel-infested nest, pulsing with a faint, bioluminescent violet light. As you slide your hand past the rim of the bracket, a dozen pale snouts whip upward from the slime, teeth clicking together like iron washers. You hold your breath, anchoring your boots against the vibrating axle while your fingers stretch toward the glowing shell, balancing on a hair-trigger between a clean grab and a nasty bite.
td-4-068.check: snatch the pearl from the eels

td-4-069.title: A Blind Strike
td-4-069.text: Steel slips against grease, and a pale shape darts from the gloom with shocking speed, sinking needle-teeth deep into the meat of your forearm. Pain flares white-hot as you jerk your arm back, slamming your elbow hard against the iron housing and bruising bone through wool. You scramble backward on your heels, sucking air through your teeth while the eel thrashes back into the dark sump. The wound leaks a slow, hot line of blood down your wrist, stinging fiercely with salt.
exits: Climb away from the grease pit

td-4-070.title: The Blind Eel's Pearl
td-4-070.text: Shafts of cold green light filter through the salt-crrusted ironwork as you step carefully across the turning brass axle, ignoring the wet snapping of blind eels striking blindly at your boots. By keeping your breathing shallow and your stance low, you reach into the slime-lined cavity of a dormant valve and pluck out a large, heavy pearl veined with streaks of oil. The smooth, cold sphere pulses faintly against your palm, carrying the trapped chill of a forgotten ocean depth.
exits: Climb back to the central junction

td-4-071.title: The Hanging Harness
td-4-071.text: A tattered leather strap dangles over the bottomless drop, supporting a small iron frame where a skeletal mechanic still sits slumped inside a rusted safety harness. The figure is long dead, dried to leather by the salt draft, but a peculiar metal implement remains gripped tightly in its rigid fingers. The abyss breathes upward with a cold, hollow roar, making the harness sway gently on its cable like a pendulum over an open grave.

td-4-072.title: Swinging Over the Abyss
td-4-072.text: You grip a rusted stay-wire with one hand and lean out over the empty dark, letting your boots drift above the invisible floor of the shaft. Below, the distant grinding of the Meridian Gear echoes like the heartbeat of a buried leviathan. The skeleton rocks in its harness as your fingers brush against its sleeve, sending a shower of flaky salt and dry cloth fragments spiraling down into the black abyss.
exits: Pry the metal from stiff fingers

td-4-073.title: The Tuning Fork
td-4-073.text: A heavy bronze tuning fork rests in the dead mechanic's hand, its twin tines notched with fine calibrations designed to match the pitch of the great gear's locking pins. As you pry the cold metal from the rigid fingers, the entire supporting wire groans and slips an inch lower into the shaft, throwing your weight off balance over the sheer drop. You freeze instantly, holding every muscle tight as you wait to see if the frayed strands will hold.

td-4-074.title: A Sudden Drop
td-4-074.text: The wire snaps with a sharp, metallic ping, and the harness plunges six inches before the safety dog catches with a bone-jarring slam. The sudden jolt wrenches your shoulder joint and rattles your teeth, knocking the breath from your lungs in a harsh gasp. You cling to the cold stay-wire with both arms, trembling as the rusted gearworks above settle back into a groaning equilibrium. Your shoulder aches dully, but you hold the prize.

td-4-075.title: The Skeleton's Tuning Fork
td-4-075.text: Metal shudders beneath your fingers as you drop over the open edge of the walkway, dangling by one elbow above the black abyss of the shaft. You swing slightly to catch the harness of a long-dead mechanic slumped against a brass beam, holding your breath against the foul stench of stagnant copper. With careful, trembling fingers, you slip a heavy iron tuning fork from his stiff leather belt just before the entire bracket groans and slips further into the dark.
